verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote mark beside the quote and the can sitting on its purple circle, so it still reads as the original. But the attribution is set nearly as large as the quote and competes with it, the logo floats with no anchor in the middle right, and the can and circle are cut tight at the bottom edge. In B, the quote mark is huge and overpowers the small quote text squeezed into the top right. The can floats in the centre, detached from its circle, which drifts off to the bottom-right corner. That breaks the original's product-on-circle grouping and leaves the layout unbalanced and scattered.
